description: Validate and persist a reusable Python function into the skill library only after 100% of supplied `test_cases` pass in isolation, returning verification status. Use to save new tested utilities; use `oxyo_skill_invoke` to list or execute existing skills.

code.description: Pure standard-library Python source defining the `entrypoint` function.

description.description: Clear summary of inputs, algorithm, and return value for future discovery.

entrypoint.description: Top-level Python function name inside `code` invoked when running the skill.

name.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the reusable skill.

share_collective.description: Opt-in to share anonymized verified utility patterns with the collective skill pool (default false; skills stay strictly private to your vault).

test_cases.description: Non-empty list of test objects {'args': [...], 'expected': ...} verified before saving.

uses_skills.description: Optional names of previously registered skills composed by this function.

name: oxyo_skill_register
